args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing
deeply nested arrays. Versions < 2.9.4 are affected. Pin fastjson
to 2.9.4, the patched release.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to remediate CVE-2026-31337.

## Details
- CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; all versions < 2.9.4 are affected.
- Per the advisory, 2.9.4 is the patched release; pinned to `fastjson==2.9.4`. No other dependencies changed.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**.
